description: Face-up playing cards on office-3's overhead wide camera (1920x1080). Two-colour standard-index decks (red- and blue-backed; the two decks have different court-card art). Card bodies: the gigarepo ept-faceup-v5 YOLO11n-OBB detector, unchanged weights (zero-shot on this deck), stored as fp16. Identity: CardNetFast trained here on office-3 OFC/stud footage (cls-v3).

detector.letterbox: area resize of frameCrop by min(1024/w, 480/h) (~0.575), grey 114 padding
detector.output: (6, N): cx, cy, w, h, conf, angle radians

fallbackClassifier.note: cls-v5a: cls-v3 fine-tuned (scripts/ft_cls.py) on v4b's whole-view crops plus 3,959 eye-labelled crops of the jumbo-index PokerStars deck (n1532 16:25-16:37 EST). Read only for crops where cls-v3's best card is < below or none is on top; same gate after that.

handStateNote: OfcHandState parameters (video). stripProbability > 1 turns strip reads of never-seen covered cards off; no strip reader is shipped (see README). stillKeep 0.6: a named card whose box is lost stays while >= 60 % of its 4x-downscaled footprint is unchanged since its last box (README).
